subject: [hw] IV rerun: plain tree passes M-a/M-b/M-c; M-d next blocker is V40 DMEM0_VMA (plus V41 fds/async/power, V34 ion lifetime); /tmp chain reaches M-f; authorization request
body:
Rerun after the V14 dispatch and V30 F15 fixes, plain tree (no /tmp patch except the one noted), host only, one script: bash gpu/hwcodec/host/run_vhost.sh

  N2VHOST reached M-c: first ioctl on /dev/vcu: set_object=2 get_object=1 allocations=9 gce_flushes=0 (n2vcu_stats)
  N2VHOST M-d not reached: n2ap_venc_open returned -5

M-a/M-b/M-c now pass on the plain tree. The first blocker is no longer V14/V30; it is the daemon's vsi address, and it is three package defects deep, all reproduced and fixed in /tmp (not in the tree):

1. V40 (mmap): vpud remap_shmem() reads /proc/self/maps, picks the first rw-p line of libvpud_vcodec.so, copies that range into the VCU DMEM and MAP_FIXED-maps the DMEM over its own RW data segment; its static codec tables (venc_drv_inst 0x4010ceb0 etc.) are the vcu_inst_addr it returns. Linux translates against VCU_DMEM0_VMA = the COMMIT mmap's vma->vm_start (mtk_vcu.c:1707-1711). V40 ignores the requested COMMIT address and reports dmem_guest=0x40000000, so V41 rejects 0x4010ceb0. I also corrected IV's maps text to bionic shape (RELRO r--p, page-aligned ranges), which makes vpud pick the right segment (shmem_start 0x4009e000 size 0x76000) - that part is in the tree.
   Fix: 12 lines in vcu/n2vcu.c, exact text posted to hw-v40. With it: n2ap_venc_open returns 0, M-d.

2. V41 (encode): after M-d the daemon needs (a) dma-buf fds in venc_ap_ipi_msg_enc.input_fd/bs_fd (0 -> ion_import fails), (b) an asynchronous done wait (ACK returns before POWER_ON/WAIT_ISR/PUT_BUFFER), (c) n2vc_dma_guest_unmap() must not clear AP-owned (owns=0) handles, and (d) the AP must power VENC/VENC_C1 around the job (this daemon never sends POWER_ON; the kernel powers on in venc_encode_prepare). Exact API proposal and patches posted to hw-v41.

3. V34 (ion): a share registered by the AP (n2shim_ion_register_share) dies on the daemon's ion_share_close/ion_free after the first job, so the second encode cannot import it. 8-line foreign flag patch posted to hw-v34.

With the three /tmp patches the plain vendor set now reaches:
  N2VHOST M-e first VENC window access: write VENC 0x00a8 0x00000000
  N2VHOST M-f wait_irq(RWVC_IRQ_VENC, timeout_ms=1000) reached
  N2VHOST hw power_on_venc=1 venc_ops=55 irq_waits=1 venc_waits=1 regs_calls=6
  (the encode itself still yields 0 bytes because the fake hardware has no VENC script; M-f is the milestone asked for)
No phone, no publish, all builds under /tmp/n2hw-iv.

Request: authorize me to apply the minimal V40/V41/V34 patches (12+~30+8 lines) to the tree, clearly marked and with the board posts as the record, since their owners are inactive and you said a minimal documented fix is allowed then. I will keep the patches backward compatible (new n2ap_venc_encode_fd/wait_done functions; existing callers unchanged) and rerun IV + the affected packages' suites. If you prefer owner-side application, say so and I will keep the /tmp proof only.
